claims.text: Machine learning-based molecular dynamics simulations using a carefully curated high-entropy-alloy dataset can overcome limitations in determining solid and liquid thermodynamic properties across a large compositional space.
The proposed intervention can determine melting temperature more accurately, accessibly, and efficiently than current experimental and computational methods.
The proposed intervention can determine enthalpy of fusion more accurately, accessibly, and efficiently than current experimental and computational methods.
The proposed intervention can determine entropy of fusion more accurately, accessibly, and efficiently than current experimental and computational methods.
The proposed intervention can determine volume change upon melting more accurately, accessibly, and efficiently than current experimental and computational methods.
The proposed intervention can determine liquid thermodynamic properties more accurately, accessibly, and efficiently than current experimental and computational methods.
The machine-learning algorithm learns patterns from molecular dynamics simulations.
Learning these patterns enables accurate prediction of thermodynamic properties across different compositions.
Learning these patterns enables accurate prediction of thermodynamic properties across different temperatures.
The proposed method is applicable to high-entropy alloys containing 3 to 10 principal elements.
The proposed method is applicable over the temperature range 500 to 2000 K.
Deviation of the predicted values from independent experimental reference data by more than 10% is defined as falsifying the hypothesis.
